unit.SPEARMAN.name: Spearman
unit.SPEARMAN.desc: Versatile foot soldier that can move, fight, build structures, and capture enemy buildings.
unit.SWORDSMAN.name: Swordsman
unit.SWORDSMAN.desc: Heavy infantry with superior combat strength. Unlocked by the Swordsman Training tech. Cleave can be researched separately.
unit.ARCHER.name: Archer
unit.ARCHER.desc: Ranged attacker that strikes from {attackRange} tiles away without stepping into melee range.
unit.CROSSBOWMAN.desc: Armor-piercing ranged attacker with {attackRange}-tile reach: ignores the target's defensive bonuses and stuns heavily-armored foes. After firing, its own DEF drops {reloadPenalty}% until its next turn.
unit.RIDER.name: Rider
unit.RIDER.desc: Swift cavalry that covers {moveRange} tiles per move to outflank and pressure the enemy.
unit.SIEGE.name: Siege
unit.SIEGE.desc: Long-range bombard with {attackRange}-tile reach; cannot fire in the same turn it moves.
unit.SCOUT.name: Scout
unit.SCOUT.desc: Light and fast explorer. Can gain special abilities through technology upgrades.
unit.GUARD.name: Guard
unit.GUARD.desc: Heavily armored defender with high defense; cannot attack in the same turn it moves.
unit.MAGE.name: Mage
unit.MAGE.desc: Arcane caster that casts spells instead of attacking, with {attackRange}-tile range and {spellsPerTurn, plural, one {# spell cast} other {# spell casts}} per turn. Recruited from active Crystal Chambers.
unit.EMBER_DEMON.name: Ember Demon
unit.SKELETON.name: Skeleton
unit.SKELETON.desc: Undead warrior raised from a gravestone.
unit.GARGOYLE.name: Gargoyle
unit.GARGOYLE.desc: Flying skeletal gargoyle raised from a Gravestone. Melee attacker that flies {moveRange} tiles over canyons and water.
unit.CROSSBOWMAN.name: Crossbowman
unit.LAVA_GRUNT.name: Lava Grunt
unit.LAVA_GRUNT.desc: Standard enemy foot soldier. Can corrupt terrain to create hostile buildings.
unit.LAVA_ARCHER.name: Lava Archer
unit.LAVA_ARCHER.desc: Enemy ranged unit that attacks from {attackRange} tiles away.
unit.LAVA_RIDER.name: Lava Rider
unit.LAVA_RIDER.desc: Enemy fast cavalry that covers {moveRange} tiles per move.
unit.LAVA_SIEGE.name: Lava Siege
unit.REAPER.name: Reaper
unit.REAPER.desc: Brutal cluster-breaker. Cleaves into adjacent enemies and grows stronger when surrounded.
unit.LANCER.name: Lancer
unit.LANCER.desc: Fast lancer that pierces through front lines, dealing full damage to units behind the target. Immune to stun.
unit.BULLWARK.name: Bullwark
unit.BULLWARK.desc: Heavily armored brute that ignores defensive bonuses and stuns heavily armored targets. Resistant to melee damage.
unit.KINDLER.name: Kindler
unit.KINDLER.desc: Ranged firestarter that scorches the target's tile.
unit.GRIMBEAK.name: Grimbeak
unit.GRIMBEAK.desc: Resilient lava beast that resists damage from summoned units, deals {summonedDamageMultiplier}× damage to them, and prioritises attacking summoned units. Grows enraged in dense clusters.
unit.RIFTWORM.name: Riftworm
unit.RIFTWORM.desc: Digs underground and re-emerges {tunnelRangeMin}–{tunnelRangeMax} tiles south in the same column, avoiding resource terrain and other Riftworms' planned exits. Digging in requires open ground (no buildings, ruins, forest or mountain). On emergence, deals {emergenceDamage} damage to all adjacent player units and corrupts the tile.
unit.RIFT_LORD.name: Rift Lord
unit.RIFT_LORD.desc: Glass-cannon caster that opens portals behind the player line, allowing enemy units to teleport into the backline.
unit.EMBERLING.name: Emberling
unit.EMBERLING.desc: Sacrificial fire spirit that seeks lava. Reaching lava destroys it and raises Ember by {emberGain}. Its EXPLODE action is available when it is blocked from reaching lava and next to player units; it deals {explosionDamage} damage to all player units within {adjacencyRange} tile and destroys itself.
unit.CAVE_MONSTER.name: Cave Monster
unit.CAVE_MONSTER.desc: A monstrous creature that emerged from deep within a mountain cave.
unit.CRYSTAL_DRAKE.name: Crystal Drake
unit.CRYSTAL_DRAKE.desc: A flying Drake summoned at a Crystal Cave. If its Crystal Cave is lost, the drake dies.
building.STRONGHOLD.name: Stronghold
building.STRONGHOLD.desc: Your capital - if you lose all your strongholds, the game is over.
building.MINE.name: Mine
building.MINE.desc: Produces {ironPerTurn} iron per turn, the primary resource for training units.
building.WOODCUTTER.name: Woodcutter
building.WOODCUTTER.desc: Produces {woodPerTurn} wood per turn, used alongside iron for buildings and recruitment.
building.BARRACKS.name: Barracks
building.BARRACKS.desc: Military hall that trains Spearman and Swordsman.
building.ARCHER_CAMP.name: Archer Camp
building.RIDER_CAMP.name: Rider Camp
building.SIEGE_CAMP.name: Siege Camp
building.SIEGE_CAMP.desc: Engineering works that trains Siege engines.
building.WATCHTOWER.name: Watchtower
building.WATCHTOWER.desc: Defensive tower that attacks enemies within {attackRange} tiles and expands your vision.
building.OUTPOST.name: Outpost
building.OUTPOST.desc: Field fortification built by Spearmen via Fieldwork (costs {woodCost} wood). Attacks enemies within {attackRange} tiles. Starting HP is based on the building unit's current HP, capped at {maxHp}.
building.LAVALAIR.name: Lava Lair
building.LAVALAIR.desc: Enemy spawner building. Produces Lava Grunt units.
building.INFERNALSANCTUM.name: Infernal Sanctum
building.INFERNALSANCTUM.desc: Enemy zone stronghold. Capturing it triggers a Sanctum Collapse.
building.FARM.name: Farm
building.FARM.desc: Housing for common folk - each pop raised lets you field one more basic unit.
building.PATRICIANHOUSE.name: Patrician House
building.PATRICIANHOUSE.desc: Noble estate - each noble raised lets you field one more elite unit.
building.MAGMASPYR.name: Magma Spyr
building.MAGMASPYR.desc: Corrupted mountain spire that attacks nearby units up to {maxAttacksPerTurn} times per turn.
building.EMBERNEST.name: Ember Nest
building.EMBERNEST.desc: Corrupted forest nest that spawns Emberlings every {spawnInterval, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}.
building.CRYSTAL_CHAMBER.name: Crystal Chamber
building.CRYSTAL_CHAMBER.desc: Arcane resonator. When a Crystal Chamber is consumed by lava, all surviving chambers begin resonating and generate {crystalsPerTurn, plural, one {# crystal} other {# crystals}} per turn. While active, Mages can be recruited once Arcane Awakening is researched.
building.GRAVESTONE.name: Gravestone
building.GRAVESTONE.desc: The grave of a fallen warrior. Revive the unit by paying {reviveCrystalCost} crystal.
building.GRAVE_TRAP.name: Grave Trap
building.GRAVE_TRAP.desc: A magic trap forged from a gravestone. The next enemy to step onto it is stunned for {stunTurns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}, along with all adjacent enemies. The trap is consumed on trigger.
building.CRYSTAL_TOWER.name: Crystal Tower
building.CRYSTAL_TOWER.desc: Arcane combat tower. Attacks enemies within {attackRange} tiles. Each enemy unit it kills generates {crystalReward} crystal. Gains +{chamberAttackBonus} attack per connected Crystal Chamber within {chamberConnectRange} tiles.
building.CRYSTAL_CAVE.name: Crystal Cave
building.CRYSTAL_CAVE.desc: Conjured mountain hollow that hosts a single Crystal Drake. While resonating, it can summon a Crystal Drake. If the cave falls (lava, capture, conversion, destruction) any bound drake dies with it.
building.CHARCOAL_KILN.name: Charcoal Kiln
building.CHARCOAL_KILN.desc: Grants +{ironBonus} iron per turn per in-range kiln to each mine and deep mine within {radius} tiles.
building.DEEP_MINE.name: Deep Mine
building.DEEP_MINE.desc: Produces {ironPerTurn} iron per turn. An advanced mine that delves deeper into the mountain to extract richer ore veins.
building.MARKET.name: Market
building.MARKET.desc: A neutral market. Offers appear when the market is discovered. A unit standing here may Trade {tradesPerTurn, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} per turn for {resourceSlots, plural, one {# resource swap} other {# resource swaps}} and {specialistSlots, plural, one {# specialist offer} other {# specialist offers}}. Trading ends the unit's turn. Includes {freeRestocks, plural, one {# free restock} other {# free restocks}} every {freeRestockInterval, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}. Destroyed only by lava.
building.BRIDGE.name: Bridge
building.BRIDGE.desc: A timber bridge spanning a single canyon tile between two land tiles. Cross along its axis or diagonally; lava destroys it.
building.SCOUT_TRAP.name: Scout Trap
building.SCOUT_TRAP.desc: A concealed trap laid by a Scout. The next non-Flying enemy to enter it takes {damage} damage and is stunned for {stunTurns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}, then the trap is consumed.

tag.RANGED.label: Ranged
tag.RANGED.desc: Attacks from a distance and does not move onto a defeated enemy's tile.
tag.PREP.label: Prep
tag.PREP.desc: Cannot attack after moving. Must attack before moving, or forgo movement entirely.
tag.BUILDANDCAPTURE.label: Build & Capture
tag.BUILDANDCAPTURE.desc: Can construct buildings on ruins and resource terrain (forest/mountain), and capture enemy buildings. Strongholds and Watchtowers transfer to your faction; other enemy buildings are demolished.
tag.SACRIFICIAL.label: Sacrificial
tag.SACRIFICIAL.desc: Prioritizes walking toward the lava to be consumed.
tag.EXPLOSIVE.label: Explosive
tag.EXPLOSIVE.desc: Deals heavy area damage to adjacent enemies when next to an enemy (preemptive self-detonation).
tag.FIELDWORK.label: Fieldwork
tag.FIELDWORK.desc: Can sacrifice itself on its current tile to instantly erect an Outpost (costs {woodCost} wood; HP scales with the unit's current HP × {hpMultiplier}). Cannot be used on ruins or resource terrain.
tag.ASSASSIN.label: Assassin
tag.ASSASSIN.desc: Deals {damageMultiplier}× damage and receives no retaliation when striking an enemy that is still at full health.
tag.PATCHUP.label: Patch Up
tag.PATCHUP.desc: Can spend its action to restore {healAmount} HP on an adjacent friendly unit. Cannot heal Summoned or Brandmarked units.
tag.PHALANX.label: Phalanx
tag.PHALANX.desc: Grants +{defenseBonus} defense to each adjacent friendly unit and gains +{attackBonus} attack per adjacent friendly unit. Bonuses apply during combat only.
tag.CORRUPT.label: Corrupt
tag.CORRUPT.desc: Places an Ember Nest on forest tiles and a Magma Spyr on mountain tiles. Corrupts the tile.
tag.PASSIVE.label: Passive
tag.PASSIVE.desc: Cannot initiate attacks. Still defends at full effectiveness when attacked by enemies.
tag.LANCE_CHARGE.label: Lance Charge
tag.LANCE_CHARGE.desc: Gains +{attackBonus} attack when striking without having moved this turn.
tag.KNIGHT.label: Knight
tag.KNIGHT.desc: Heavily armoured cavalry with +{maxHpBonus} max HP.
tag.HIT_AND_RUN.label: Hit and Run
tag.HIT_AND_RUN.desc: Can move before and after attacking; post-attack movement is limited to {postAttackMoveRange} tile. DEF is reduced by {defensePenalty} as a trade-off for the added mobility.
tag.OUTRIDER.label: Outrider
tag.OUTRIDER.desc: +{moveBonus} movement range. Optimised for deep raids.
tag.COVER.label: Cover
tag.SKIRMISHER.label: Skirmisher
tag.PIN_DOWN.label: Pin Down
tag.PIN_DOWN.desc: Each hit has a {stunChancePct}% chance to stun the target. It cannot move or attack on its next action.
tag.DISTRACTION.label: Distraction
tag.DISTRACTION.desc: Each hit permanently reduces the target's DEF by {defenseReduction}. Archer ATK is reduced by {attackReduction}.
tag.PREVENTIVE_STRIKE.label: Preventive Strike
tag.PREVENTIVE_STRIKE.desc: When an enemy moves from outside into this siege unit's attack range during an enemy turn, it automatically fires, dealing {damagePercent}% of its normal attack damage. Suppressed while the siege unit stands on a Corrupted tile.
tag.ELITE.label: Elite
tag.ELITE.desc: +{maxHpBonus} max HP. Elite unit forged in the noble tradition.
tag.FORTIFIED_GARRISON.label: Fortified Garrison
tag.FORTIFIED_GARRISON.desc: Attack building gains +{attackBonus} ATK and +{rangeBonus} attack range.
tag.BLOODLUST.label: Bloodlust
tag.BLOODLUST.desc: When this Rider kills an enemy, it may make an extra attack that turn at half attack without retaliation.
tag.SPLASH.label: Splash
tag.SPLASH.desc: Deals {damagePercent}% of dealt damage to all enemy units surrounding the target.
tag.READY.label: Ready
tag.READY.desc: Can move and attack immediately after being recruited.
tag.REVIVABLE.label: Revivable
tag.REVIVABLE.desc: Leaves a Gravestone on death. Pay {reviveCrystalCost} crystal to revive.
tag.SUMMONED.label: Summoned
tag.SUMMONED.desc: Conjured by magic. Does not consume population, cannot be healed, and does not leave a gravestone on death.
tag.BRANDMARKED.label: Brandmarked
tag.BRANDMARKED.desc: +{attackBonus} ATK. Loses {hpLossPerTurn} HP at the end of every player turn. Cannot be healed by Patch Up. On death, leaves behind a hostile Ember Demon.
tag.LEASHED.label: Leashed
tag.LEASHED.desc: Summoned creature bound to a Mage. If the Mage moves beyond its attack range or dies, the leashed unit defects to the enemy.
tag.NO_GRAVESTONE.label: No Gravestone
tag.NO_GRAVESTONE.desc: Leaves no body. Cannot become a Gravestone on death.
tag.LEAVES_GRAVESTONE.label: Leaves Gravestone
tag.LAVA.label: Lava
tag.LAVA.desc: Lava-faction unit. Immune to Burning tile damage. Retained even when faction changes.
tag.CLEAVE.label: Cleave
tag.CLEAVE.desc: On hit, deals {damagePercent}% damage to all enemy units adjacent to both attacker and defender. Ignores Phalanx defense.
tag.PIERCE.label: Pierce
tag.PIERCE.desc: Deals {primaryDamagePercent}% damage to the target; the enemy unit or building directly behind the target takes {secondaryDamagePercent}% of the standard attack damage.
tag.RAGE.label: Rage
tag.RAGE.desc: Gains +{attackPerAdjacent} attack per adjacent enemy, up to {adjacentCap} enemies (maximum +{attackCap}).
tag.ALERT.label: Alert
tag.IRONBLOOD.label: Ironblood
tag.IRONBLOOD.desc: Takes only {damagePercent}% damage from attacks by Summoned units.
tag.BLOCK.label: Block
tag.BLOCK.desc: Takes only {damagePercent}% damage from melee attackers.
tag.PUNCTURE.label: Puncture
tag.PUNCTURE.desc: Ignores defensive bonuses on the target. Stuns targets with base DEF above {defenseThreshold} for {stunDuration, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}.
tag.RELOAD.label: Reload
tag.RELOAD.desc: After this unit attacks, its DEF is reduced by {defensePenaltyPct}% until the start of its next turn.
tag.BURN.label: Burn
tag.BURN.desc: Attacks set the target's tile to Burning, dealing damage to non-Lava, non-Flying, non-Cinderborn units standing there at end of turn.
tag.TUNNEL.label: Tunnel
tag.TUNNEL.desc: Digs underground and re-emerges {rangeMin}–{rangeMax} tiles south in the same column. Digging in requires open ground (no buildings, ruins, forest or mountain). Deals {emergenceDamage} damage to enemies adjacent to the emergence tile. Sets the emergence tile to Corrupted.
tag.EMBER_PORTAL.label: Ember Portal
tag.EMBER_PORTAL.desc: Casts a pair of portals: an entrance next to the Rift Lord and an exit behind the player's frontline. Any enemy unit stepping on the entrance teleports to the exit, if the exit is free. If the exit is blocked, the unit waits on the entrance and teleports the moment the exit clears. The Rift Lord cannot cast another pair until the current pair is removed. Portal tiles are Corrupted and block player movement.
tag.HOMELESS.label: Homeless
tag.HOMELESS.desc: Unit has no shelter; population cap is exceeded. -{defensePenalty} DEF. Loses {hpLossPerTurn} HP at the end of every player turn.
tag.UNTRAINED.label: Untrained
tag.UNTRAINED.desc: Training facilities of this type are over capacity. -{attackPenalty} ATK.
tag.FLYING.label: Flying
tag.FLYING.desc: Traverses canyons and unfrozen water tiles. Survives knockback over canyons and water (lava still kills). Immune to Burning tile damage. Does not ice-slide across frozen tiles. Takes +{rangedDamageTakenPct}% damage from non-Flying ranged attackers.
tag.CORRUPTED.label: Corrupted
tag.CORRUPTED.desc: Standing on a Corrupted tile. Some tag abilities are suppressed until this unit moves off the Corrupted tile.
tag.BRIDGE_BUILDER.label: Bridgebuilder
tag.BRIDGE_BUILDER.desc: Can spend its action to build a Bridge ({woodCost} wood) across a one-tile canyon gap between two land tiles. Bridge is crossable along its axis and diagonally.
tag.KNOCKBACK.label: Knockback
tag.KNOCKBACK.desc: On hit, pushes the target one tile away. Lava kills any pushed unit. Non-Flying units die if pushed into a canyon or water tile. Pushing onto a frozen tile causes an ice-slide. Units and occupied buildings block the push (no bonus damage). Flying units can still be pushed but survive canyons and water.
tag.CINDERBORN.label: Cinderborn
tag.CINDERBORN.desc: Recruited within {rows} rows of the lava front. Gains +{attackBonus} ATK and immunity to Burning tile damage.
tag.BERSERK.label: Berserk
tag.BERSERK.desc: When HP drops below {hpThresholdPct}%, gains +{attackPct}% ATK. Once triggered, stays active even if HP recovers.
tag.BATTERY.label: Battery
tag.BATTERY.desc: Gains +{attackPerAdjacent} ATK per adjacent friendly unit, up to {stackCap} stacks.
terrainTag.CORRUPTED.label: Corrupted
terrainTag.CORRUPTED.desc: Player units on this tile are isolated from ally tag interactions. No Phalanx bonuses, no Patch Up healing, no Pin Down / Distraction / Splash effects on attack, and no tag-based attack bonuses (Knight, Lance Charge, Assassin, Bloodlust). Preventive Strike overwatch is also suppressed. Base stats, movement, ranged capability, and persistent effects (Brandmarked) remain unchanged.
terrainTag.FROZEN.label: Frozen
terrainTag.FROZEN.desc: Units that end movement on this tile slide one additional tile in their movement direction. Sliding into water, canyon, or lava is fatal. Spawning directly onto a frozen tile triggers no slide. Flying units do not slide.
terrainTag.BURNING.label: Burning
terrainTag.BURNING.desc: Non-Lava, non-Flying, non-Cinderborn units on this tile take {damage} damage at the end of each turn.
